findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed an accumulation of frost on ice cream freezer. Defrost freezer.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
REPEAT-Provide a chemical test kit for checking the concentration of sanitizing solution during ware washing in the 3 compartment sink.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Drip tray of cappuccino machine is soiled with food debris. Clean drip tray.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: (NEW) 750.810g - Provide a chemical test kit for checking the concentration of sanitizing solution during ware washing in the 3 part sink. A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) soda nozzles/diffusers & B) detachable pieces of cappuccino machine. Food contact surfaces shall be washed, rinse, and sanitized between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris. Properly clean and sanitize food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) shelves in walkin cooler (plastic dividers for bottled/canned drinks); B) drink counter; C) cabinets below drink counter; D) soda display and other shelves; & E) ice cream freezer - around edge of door seal (dirt/debris). Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: (NEW) 750.1060 - Faucet of 3 part sink leaks at both handles when water is turned on. Repair the 3 part sink so the faucet does not leak. All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Properly repair the 3 part sink in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1220 - Floors were soiled in the walkin cooler under shelves and in the storage area. Clean the floors as needed and maintain them clean.

**Raise lower shelves in storage area and in the walkin cooler up off the ground so floors can be properly cleaned underneath shelving units.**

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: (NEW) 750.1210 - Three part sink needs to be sealed to the wall with caulk. All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Dishwashing facilities designed, constructed, operated (1. wash 2. rinse 3. sanitize)
findings.citation_text: 750.820 - Three compartment sink has been removed and is no longer available for use to properly clean and sanitize the food contact surfaces of the soda & cappuccino machines. A 3 part sink must be installed and used to properly clean and sanitize food contact surfaces such as soda nozzles, diffuser, and the detachable pieces of the cappuccino machine. Re-install a 3 part sink or discontinue use of the soda & cappuccino machines and remove them from the premises. If more time is needed to re-install the 3 part sink for some reason, call for an extension to the follow-up deadline of 4/9/12 (see general comments).

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.citation_text: 750.820 - Detachable pieces of cappuccino & soda machines are not being properly cleaned and sanitized due to the removal of the 3 part sink. Food contact surfaces must be properly cleaned and sanitized. Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4). Properly clean and sanitize the soda nozzles, diffusers, and detachable pieces of the cappuccino machine.
